[list]
[*] Open Steam and go to your library.
[*] Right-click on Animal Shelter and select Properties.

notes.title: 🎄Christmas Event🎄 + UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1][b]🎄 It’s time for the Christmas Event in Animal Shelter! 🎄[/b][/h1]

[h2]The holiday season is upon us, and just like every year, we’re keeping the Christmas Event tradition alive in our beloved Animal Shelter! This year, we’re bringing even more holiday cheer with a bunch of festive goodies and updates. Get ready to celebrate with your furry friends in style![/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/2db57b4bf3fe076f1caf458a2716073459dbf85b.png[/img]



[h3][b]Event Details 🎅🎁[/b][/h3]

[b]Setting the mood 🥰[/b]
The most important part of the holiday makeover? SNOW, of course! ❄️ It’s snowing everywhere! So, put on your warmest coat and have a blast playing in the winter wonderland. And guess what? We’ve also updated the UI to make it extra festive, plus there’s a cheerful holiday tune playing in the background to get you in the spirit! 🎶

[b]Holiday items 🎁[/b]
The chilly weather has brought back a long-lost friend—a penguin! 🐧 You can place him wherever you like, so make sure he has a cozy spot! Plus, we’ve got a bunch of other themed decorations: gingerbread houses, snowballs, and of course, lots and lots of candies! 🍬

[b]Clothes for your pupils 🐶[/b]
That’s right, the festive holiday clothes are back! 🎉 Get your animals ready for the season with Santa hats 🧢, elves’ shoes 👟, and more! We can’t wait to see the fun costumes you come up with. Share your creativity with us on Discord!

[b]Furniture 🪑[/b]
Time to decorate your shelter! Place a snowman outside ⛄, or even Santa’s sleigh 🎅 (we may have borrowed it). Plus, we’ve got some cool DLC items, like interactive snow for the Horse DLC and Vet DLC. There are also festive fence decorations for the Horse DLC!

[b]Changes around You 💞[/b]
There’s holiday cheer all around—Christmas posters 🎄, candy sprinkled on the office sign 🍬🤤, and festive Christmas lights 💡. We’ve also added holiday wreaths on the garlands and a new festive gate ✨. Plus, there are special DLC decorations to bring even more Christmas magic to your shelters!

[b]Event exclusive items 🤯[/b]
Don’t forget, any furniture or items you buy and place during the event will stay with you after it ends! But some things, like clothes for animals, snow, the sky change, and the gate will disappear once the event is over, so make sure to enjoy them while they’re here! 🤗



[h3][b]But wait, there’s more! We’ve been working hard on a patch to fix some of the most reported issues by you, our amazing community. So, alongside the Christmas Event, we’re also releasing NEW Patch! Check out the details below:[/b][/h3]



[b]Patch notes: [/b]
✅ Fixed issue with washing animals not affecting their cleanliness stat
✅ Fixed "Horse ride" achievement
✅ Fixed "Luxury stud" achievement
✅ Fixed "A trip" achievement
✅ Made the "Warehouse" popup optional for the "Know-it-all" achievement
✅ Decreased inspection timers to make "The clean guy" achievement easier

✅ Fixed issue with getting stuck while being on a leash behind the player
✅ Animals defecate more often while sick
✅ Blocked entrance to Vet Clinic from DLC
✅ Corrected pillow tooltip shown when an animal is laying on a pillow
✅ Fixed ear cleaners hologram
✅ Removed unnecessary collisions for a performance boost in some cases
✅ Removed tooltip "Medical card" when taking animal from a van
✅ Fixed issue where it sometimes teleported a horse for no reason
✅ Corrected some translations

[h3]We hope you’re as excited as we are to dive into the Christmas Event and enjoy the new update! 🎉✨ So grab your holiday spirit, gather your animals, and let’s celebrate the season in style![/h3]

[b]Happy holidays from the Animal Shelter team! 🎄🐾[/b]

notes.title: What has changed? AS1 vs AS2 Prologue
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello Animal Lovers! 👋[/b][/h2]

We're thrilled to announce that Animal Shelter 2 Prologue is just around the corner with a release date set for [b]September 13th! 🎉[/b] 

To get you ready for the big day, we’ve put together a list of exciting new features and improvements that set it apart from the original *Animal Shelter*. We can’t wait for you to dive into the game and experience all the amazing changes! 🐾


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/d4d2127e7412dae1a1869b5ba590c176132dfb11.png[/img]


[b]🌟 All-new graphics[/b]
The visuals have been significantly upgraded, especially for the animals, who now look more realistic and adorable than ever before!

[b]🏠 Enhanced shelter customization[/b]
While you can no longer move buildings, you now have much more control over customizing your existing shelter. Change walls, ceilings, floors, and even expand some rooms to suit your needs!

[b]👥 Other characters[/b]
Meet NPC workers  and adopters  who visit your shelter. This brings a new layer of interaction and managing people around you.

[b]🤝 CO-OP mode[/b]
Yes, you heard that right! Animal Shelter 2 Prologue introduces multiplayer co-op mode, so you can run the shelter with your friends or alone!

[b]🚑 External services[/b]
Need a special treatment for an animal? Now you can send them outside the shelter for surgeries or treatments, adding more depth to the care management system.

[b]🗺️ 2D world map[/b]
Explore the world outside the shelter! Use the new 2D map to discover events, activities, and interventions waiting for you and your animals.

[b]🚓 Intervention missions[/b]
Now you can personally go on rescue missions, entering different locations to help animals in need. These locations are partially procedurally generated, so each visit offers a new experience.

[b]🐶 Puppies and kittens included[/b]
No more waiting for DLC! Puppies and kittens are available from the start in [b]Animal Shelter 2 Prologue[/b], ready to melt your heart.

[b]🐕 Your own pet[/b]
You can now have a personal pet that follows you around the shelter, keeping you company as you manage your daily tasks.

[b]📝 More advanced mission system[/b]
In Animal Shelter 2 Prologue, the missions are more complex and varied.

[b]🧠 Improved animal AI[/b]
Animals in the game are now more realistic. They have their own behaviors, needs, and desires. They interact with other animals and might show unwanted behaviors that you'll need to correct, making animal care more demanding.

[b]🩺 More involved animal care[/b]
Caring for animals in Animal Shelter 2 Prologue goes beyond just physical needs. You’ll also need to manage mental and behavioral issues before the animals are ready for adoption. Every pet requires a unique approach, adding depth to the gameplay.

[b]🌗 Day and night cycle[/b]
The game now features a dynamic day and night system, which not only changes the aesthetics of the shelter but also affects daily tasks. 

[b]📱 Tablet replaces the camera[/b]
You no longer need a separate camera to take photos. All images and documents are now managed through a tablet, which serves as your "command center" in the shelter, simplifying the management process.

[b]💉 Expanded healing system[/b]
The healing system is now more detailed. Some animals will require long-term treatments, while others might need specialized care outside the shelter. You may also encounter animals with chronic health issues that require ongoing management while they stay in your care.

[b]👵 Older animals[/b]
The game now includes older animals, which have their own unique traits. They may tire faster, require more care, and can be harder to adopt out. These elderly pets add a new level of challenge to shelter management.

[b]👗 Animals can wear clothes and decorations[/b]
You can now dress your animals in clothes and decorations not only during photoshoots but anytime. This adds a personal touch to the shelter, making it even more unique and heartwarming.

[b]🐾 DLC features from the original game are now included in the base game[/b]
Features such as walking animals on leashes, using the tablet for management, and animals running freely around the shelter are now part of the base game. You can also place animals anywhere in the shelter, not just in designated spots as in the first game.

[b]🧹 Better shelter cleaning system[/b]
The cleaning system has been improved.

[b]🎁 More perks and new features[/b]
The game introduces other smaller yet important improvements like the auto-disappearance of empty delivery boxes, new gameplay-impacting perks, and overall adoption system improvements.

[previewyoutube=u1Azx7_YBlE;full][/previewyoutube]

---

We’re incredibly excited for you to experience all these new features in [b]Animal Shelter 2 Prologue[/b] when it launches [b]on September 13th[/b]! 🐾 Add the game to your wishlist now and [b]join us on Discord for the latest updates![/b]

See you soon,
Animal Shelter 1 & 2 Team

notes.title: Patch 1.3.11
notes.content:
[b]Changes and additions:[/b]
- Infectious diseases will now transmit less aggressively between animals so there should be more time to cure or isolate sick animals.
- Improved visualization of the litterbox hologram during placement and adjusted its position in the player's hand (so the litterbox doesn't obstruct the view as much).
- To avoid save errors that may occur, we've added a very short block on the ability to save the game while an animal is being given up for adoption (from the moment of interaction with the van/carrier until the adoption summary screen is closed).
- The ability to interact with a carrier that is not empty (that is bringing an animal to the shelter) has been disabled while holding another animal that is intended to be adopted out to a new owner. In the case of a mixed queue of cars to the shelter (meaning one or more cars are coming to pick up an animal, and one or more cars are bringing a new animal to the shelter), there was a possibility of bugs in the not-empty carrier in the van when interacting with it while holding an animal that you wanted to adopt out. This would break the carrier with the animal inside and make it impossible to take it out from the transporter.

- Fixed a bug that could cause an animal to remain locked as 'Promised for adoption' even when the person it was promised to no longer exists in the database.
- Helpers with the "Caretaker" function have been retrained and should no longer break water and food containers (bowls and troughs). A bug has been removed that sometimes prevented animals from using these containers after they were filled by a helper.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.10
notes.content:
[u][b]Changes and additions:[/b][/u]
- We've heard your feedback regarding the difficulty of collecting stool samples. While we still don't plan on adding laxatives we've simplified the process while still maintaining a somewhat realistic approach to veterinary care. From now on, all animals that require stool examination will only defecate in this manner (they won't pee at all, but will poop every time). Additionally, sick cats and kittens that need a stool sample will not use a litter box (even if one is available near by), ensuring the valuable sample isn't lost in cat litter.
- We've toned down the effect of the "Lack of Appetite" symptom. Animals with this symptom will still be less eager to eat than usual, but the difference will be less drastic than originally.
- The horse placed on the treatment platform was overly curious and sometimes its head movements made it difficult to conduct a proper examination (especially auscultation). We've reduced the mobility of horses standing on the platform to prevent them from interfering too much in examinations with their sudden movements.
- We've marked some perks as mutually exclusive, ensuring they cannot be present on the same animal simultaneously (e.g., Aggressive and Calm/Quiet/Relaxed/Polite, etc.).

[b][u]Bug fixes:[/u][/b]
- Overzealous assistants with "cleaner" function will no longer remove the hay bedding in horse stalls.
- Medical cabinets are now also available for purchase in the horse shelter.
- Fixed a bug that occasionally caused the game to improperly save certain statuses of animals, leading to issues like the health stat dropping to zero and the overall stat value displaying as NaN.
- Fixed a bug that caused slim horses to occasionally load with the 'heavy' body type.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.7
notes.content:
[b][u]Changes and additions:[/u][/b]
[b]- We've adjusted the treatment for pets with 'Stomach Ulcers'. We've reduced the amount of veterinary food required for treatment from two doses to just one. We realized that asking you to feed an ailing pet, often with a reduced appetite due to the illness, frequently led to challenges in timely healing. This change should make recovery more achievable. Furthermore, for illnesses requiring veterinary food treatment, we've reduced the health degradation rate for the sick pets. This gives players more time to wait for the pet to get hungry again, allowing for a more manageable treatment process.[/b]
- We've fine-tuned the "pop" sound effect, which you might recognize from when a new panel appears (like when there's a new pet available for adoption on the computer). This sound will now be half as loud and have half the previous range. But be aware, if you're carrying a tablet with an open window that can produce this sound (e.g., the 'Pets to take in' window), escaping it won't be an option – sadly, character movement speeds in our game fall short of Mach 1. If you find yourself pursued by persistent popping, the recommended solution is to close the windows on your tablet.

[b]- Fixed an issue that was preventing some players from saving their game. The bug was triggered by samples taken from animals that were no longer in the shelter at the time of saving the game (e.g., a blood sample from a dog that had already been adopted). Those lingering samples were, quite literally, holding your progress hostage![/b]
- Fixed an issue where you could promise a pet to more than one person. The "promised" status wasn't saving correctly, so upon game reload, the same pet could be paired with another individual despite already being promised to someone else. Breaking promises like that is not behavior we endorse...
- Fixed a glitch where occasionally the medical cabinet would load without its doors.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.7
notes.content:
[b][u]Changes and additions:[/u][/b]
- New diseases from the Vet DLC are now available regardless if the missions are completed, disabled or enabled (before they were only available if missions were finished or disabled when using the mail box).
- We've rebalanced the generation of sick animals: after the changes in the disease system introduced in the Vet Clinic DLC, the chances of
encountering a sick animal were far too low at lower shelter reputation levels. Now, the game should offer a more balanced challenge across all reputation tiers.
- Further refinements have been made to the system that generates prospective adopters from pet adoption ads. We've enhanced the system that generates interested humans for pets based on ads. Now, if a pet doesn't have any trait considered as "positive", the system will also take into account their "neutral" traits. It's important to note that there's always a possibility of a "difficult" animal (perhaps due to traumatic past experiences, improper care, or lack of training) arriving at the shelter. Such animals might not possess traits seen by the system as either "positive" or even "neutral." Matching such an animal with a human will be more challenging. However, to boost the odds of finding the best possible new owner even more, we've also doubled the number of people responding to adoption ads. This ensures that every furry friend has a greater chance of finding a loving home.
- We've enhanced the system that generates visitors coming to the shelter for animals not listed in adoption ads. Now, the generation of potential adopters for available pets should be more precise, ensuring every kind of critter will find someone eager to welcome them into their new home.
- We've made significant adjustments to the way inventory contents of both the Warehouse and Medical Cabinet are saved. Some players reported instances of
items mysteriously disappearing or moving between the Warehouse and Medical Cabinet after saving. We believe we've pinpointed the root cause, but addressing it
required an overhaul of the save system for these elements. As a result of these changes, if players have a Medical Cabinet in their save data, upon the first load after the new patch, all items from the Medical Cabinet should be safely transferred to the Warehouse. This is a necessary step to "reset" incorrectly saved item parameters. After this adjustment, everything should return to normal. Feel free to move items back from Warehouse to the Medical Cabinet, and they should now be saved and loaded correctly.
- We've improved using microscopes by disabling exiting the mini-game by using the secondary/alternative interaction button (which happed a lot by accident). Additionally, when the sample is "infected", the chance of detecting an infection while scanning key points in the sample is increased (from 50% to 75%), making it easier to detect an infection using the microscope mini-game.
- Occasionally, the wound treatment status was saved incorrectly, causing the wound to load with a dressing applied, yet the Medical Chart would show that the wound needed treatment first (and it was impossible to remove the currently applied dressing). We've added a safeguard to prevent improper loading of wounds on animals, ensuring that healing goes smoothly and your pets remain in tip-top shape.
- We've supercharged your shopping experience! The maximum allowed number of items in a shop order has been cranked up from a mere 9 to a whopping 99. Time to stock up like never before!
- Horses, by mistake, were given the ability to have the "Wound" disease in the base game. However, they couldn't be treated because it required the Treatment Platform, which is exclusive to the new clinics in the Vet Clinic DLC. To resolve this, we've disabled the possibility of adding this wound to horses in the base game.

[b][u]Bug fixes:[/u][/b]
- The bandage wrapping for the paw of the Inu-inspired breed had an incorrect rotation, but it's now fixed and looking proper.
- Fixed a bug in the mission involving a dog with a sick paw that needed treatment (a block was applied incorrectly for admitting sick animals, which inadvertently stalling the mission progress).
- Fixed a bug causing some of our new decorative items (like the fresh armchairs or coffee tables) saving and loading incorrectly.
- Fixed a bug causing the urination sound effect occasionally loop way longer than intended.
- Fixed a bug where a disease would save with zero suggested tests during the diagnosis phase, resulting in an empty test recommendation list in the Medical Chart upon loading.
- Fixed a bug that prevented changing the type of food in a bowl that's already filled.
- Fixed a bug that messed with the pathfinding system near the northern wall of the shelter (ever tried to put your pet in its cage and witnessed it magically teleport out?).
- Fixed a bug causing the dog's animation when hopping into the van after adoption looking a bit off.

[b][u]Known issues and workarounds:[/u][/b]
We believe we are close to fixing the issue of disappearing animals, but it will still take a bit.
Animals are not being removed - they are still in the shelter, but unfortunately due to an error, they might become invisible.

In the meantime, here is a workaround if that ever happens to you:
- If, using superhuman tracking skills, you manage to locate such an invisible animal (it should show a tooltip then you look at it - just like with normal animals) please pick it up
- Take it to a cage in a building with walls (i.e. not to the enclosures surrounded by a mesh, but e.g. in dog/cat/puppy/kitten buildings or veterinary isolation rooms)
- Close the cage door (to prevent the animal from leaving it)
- Completely exit that building - not the ROOM, but the BUILDING - and close the door behind you
- Upon re-entering the building, the invisible animal should materialize

Why it happens (if you're interested in the details): The disappearance is caused by an error in the system that turns off objects invisible to the player to improve performance, but only in a very specific situation, precisely when the animal has the cage door open and leaves it by itself, while the main building doors are closed (so objects in that building are invisible). In such a situation, upon re-entering the building, the animal that left the cage on its own does not properly turn back on.

[b]This issues can be avoided by closing the cage doors and preventing the animals from leaving them on their own. Sorry for the temporary inconvenience.[/b]

notes.title: 📢 MAJOR UPDATE IS HERE!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Let's kick off this weekend with a Major Update! 🥳[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]There is just over a week left until the release of Vet Clinic DLC and today we come to you with a major update that also includes the additional free content to the game! You can download it right now![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/a31e4ff10435b536581064aa404f339230911cfd.png[/img]

Once again, we would like to thank you all for your feedback, logs, suggestions, and ideas 🤝 this is a real treasure trove of knowledge for us, and we always want to meet the expectations of our amazing community. 😍

[h3][b]Below is a list of things we have prepared for you 😊[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]CHANGES AND ADDITIONS:[/u][/b][/h3]
- Not everyone who cares about homeless animals can take them into their home, but any support is valuable, so every now and then, the shelter might get a pleasant surprise in the form of an email with a small sum of money.
- Saddles and bridles are pricey gear, so it's worth properly looking after them - from now on You can hang them on a fancy hanger that you can buy in Build Mode.
- Don't let your pets languish in their cages and boxes - perk them up by taking them out for a walk in the park or a joyride! Animals out on walks or rides now have more realistically adjusted stats: they get dirty a bit quicker, tire a bit more, and get hungry faster, but that's a small price to pay for a swiftly rising happiness bar, right?
- Shhh, the baby's sleeping... Just like real puppies and kittens, our virtual little ones spend a good deal of their time snoozing. So, we've adjusted their behavior to reflect this, making their sleeping patterns more believable.
- Water and food bowls can now be placed not only in cages but also in the play area (and office buildings too!), making it easier than ever for your furry friends to take a quick play-break for a drink or a snack. Refreshment is just a paw's reach away!
- During a good playtime, time seems to flow faster than usual... which isn't necessarily a good thing when you have to manage not one, but two shelters full of attention-seeking pets. So, we've implemented a change: now, when the player is occupied in one shelter, life in the other slows down a bit. This results in a slower decline of the animals' stats, giving you a better chance to keep all tails wagging!
- Extra helping hands in the shelter are always a welcome sight. That's why we've decided to expand the skillset of our brave helpers. We've sent them off to several trainings, enabling them to actively participate more in the shelter's daily life. Specializing an helper does take away the passive bonus they added to the shelter's stats, but on the bright side, you'll never trip over an empty box again - we think that's a fair trade.
- We've stocked the store with some new decorative items. Perhaps a vibrant, beautiful vase or a quaint desk globe might catch your fancy? Add a personal touch to your shelter with these appealing new additions!
- Personal space? Never heard of it... Your personal pet, once adopted by the player, is so grateful that it wants to follow its new owner everywhere. So, if its basic needs are met, it will try to tail the player. Yes: EVEN THE CAT! Experience true virtual companionship with your grateful fur buddy who simply can't bear to be apart from you.
- An option has appeared in the main menu to jump straight into the horse shelter game. But take heed, this is a choice for more seasoned players as the tutorial missions are turned off in this mode.
- You can now access a complete list of all your shelter's residents - dogs, cats, and horses - right from your computer, without having to move between shelters. Keep track of your four-legged friends with ease.
- In the game menu, you can now activate the 'click-to-move' option. This feature allows you to move objects in build mode with a simple left-click of the mouse, eliminating the need to hold the button down while dragging. Enhancing your gaming experience, one click at a time!
- Even the most diligent shelter manager can sometimes lose count in this bustling, fast-paced world of animal rescue. Thanks to new counters for incoming and outgoing pets, you'll never forget about that van carrying a new fur friend heading to your shelter. These helpful counters have been added to the appropriate panels on your computer and are also visible in the overlay accessed by pressing the TAB key.
- Horses, feeling a touch of envy of their canine and feline counterparts' modeling careers, have learned how to strike a pose, updated their wardrobe, and are now ready for their photo shoots! We've added a few interesting options for horses to our photoshoot feature. Lights, camera, gallop - your equine friends are ready for their close-ups!
- We've polished up the cage cleaning system - the tooltips have been improved, and the progress bar during floor sweeping in animal cages has been refined. Every sweep counts, ensuring our furry residents have the cleanest possible living conditions!
- You can now use brand new medical chart to see pets conditions and to help you in the diagnostic and healing process!

[h3][b][u]BUG FIXES:[/u][/b][/h3]
- Fixed a bug in Mission 09, which sometimes caused the system to not properly register the collection of a sick animal's blood sample.
- Tweaks to the cage floor cleaning mechanics - dirt on the floor should now be more visible, making it easier to ensure a 100% squeaky clean cage.
- Fixed a bug that occasionally made it impossible to bathe an Inu breed dog.
- Fixed a bug that caused the progress circle to disappear while pouring litter into the cat litter box.
- Fixed a bug that caused one of the dog actions to function improperly, which in turn caused a significant drop in the game's frame rate.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the queue of animals waiting for shelter admission to be empty, thereby hindering progress in missions aimed at leveling up the shelter's reputation.
- Fixed a bug that incorrectly modified a horse's stats during game load.
- Fixed a bug that occasionally caused horses to lose their bridles and load into the game without them.
- Fixed a bug that prevented saddles from providing the appropriate stamina bonus to horses with the "Likes Riding" perk.
- Fixed the incorrect tooltips for the carrot, syrup, and several other items that can be given to pets, which were displaying inaccurately.
- Fixed a bug that caused some items available from the Build Mode menu to become stuck when placed too close to the shelter's gate.
- Fixed a bug that allowed buildings to be placed on environmental elements (decorations, drone landing pads, etc.).

[h3][b]Thank you again for your commitment to Animal Shelter! 🐶 😺[/b][/h3]


[h1][b] Make sure to join us on the launch day of Animal Shelter - Vet Clinic DLC![/b][/h1]

[h2] [b]🗺️ WHERE[/b] - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2517260/Animal_Shelter__Vet_Clinic_DLC/]Vet Clinic DLC Steam page[/url]
[b]📍 WHEN[/b] - AUGUST 13, 2023
[b]🕒 TIME[/b] - 3:00 PM CEST/6:00 AM PDT[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2517260/Animal_Shelter__Vet_Clinic_DLC/

[url=https://discord.gg/QGAjBBe2wR][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/9f0e3dff5fa9f225bba55440f84b70e93d30e124.png[/img][/url]

Animal Shelter Team[/b]

notes.title: Free DLC!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Animal lovers! 🐶[/b][/h1]

[h2]Today we brought you amazing news! [b]THE FREE DLC IS HERE[/b]! [/h2]

[h3]It’s content is literally [b]your voice[/b] and our way to say [b]thanks for everything you’ve done[/b] 🙂 [b]New location, workers, adopting animals and MORE.[/b] Buckle up and make sure you’re in for a ride![/h3]

[h2]0️⃣ Let’s start off strong. It’s one of two [b]most requested content updates[/b]all of you were asking for! We’d like to introduce you to [b]THE NEW MAP - Park[/b]. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/20c741ec0b3a32608aca4b4daa94fa8955f883d7.png[/img]

[h3]We realize there was no place dedicated for walking your pupils… Well, until now! 🐕 Finally, we’ve finished working on the [b]entire location where you can take a stroll with your pupils[/b] on a leash 🥰 and while you're there, why not [b]play with your animals [/b]for a bit?[/h3]

[h2][b]1️⃣ An even bigger animal shelter! 🎉 [/b][/h2]

[h3]You no longer have to give up putting up more buildings and facilities. We have added more space to expand your institution so that you can take in even more pets and design the look of your shelter ❤️ [/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/9892d14a2847765ee6172720833f7604e2c0b89d.png[/img]

[h2][b]2️⃣ From now on, you’ll be able to hire workers.[/b][/h2]

[h3] You may ask [b]“how many of them can we hire?”[/b] It’s simple! The amount depends on the reputation of your shelter 😊. Each of the workers hired will [b]reduce the pace of pet’s “needs meter” deterioration[/b]. That’ll allow you to manage more pets or have even more leisure playthrough with fewer animals. 😍[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/79cd5d8a1265bf2c65134458fdc39bd450ba0a71.png[/img]

[h2]3️⃣ Before we move to the main news, let’s take a look at a list of [b]quality of life improvements[/b] we’ll introduce with this update 📝:
[/h2]

-Now you can switch between multiple screens,
-Photo gallery can be sorted,
-The movable trash cans are finally here!
-The fill / free space of items can be seen,
-New, upgraded camera control while in the animal interaction mode,
-[b]Upgraded cleaning mechanic!! Now you can clean the entire floor in the cage![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/9e3b45291b1ae304b0eb8cb12e41ea4f54837e93.png[/img]

[b][h2]4️⃣ Hold on for a moment, we also received information about some [b]changes for the animals[/b]😻.[/h2] [/b]
[h3]From now on, you’ll be able to [b]receive and give away more than one pet at the same time [/b]😀. And while we’re on it, you can[b] change animals’ names and edit their descriptions [/b]🤩
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/b1d18f7bb348663057c8582301a59a33484396d8.png[/img]

[h2][b]5️⃣ You asked us multiple times to make some behavioral changes for your cuties.[/b][/h2] 
[h3]No problem! [b]Now pets will be able to go into their respective dog houses, lay on pillows[/b] and so on 👍 Oh, them[b] running off and going to the enclosure is no longer a bug, it’s a feature[/b]😎![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/814cf772285a7211059578de46babe3c0b95cc84.png[/img]

[h2]6️⃣ That brings us to [b]the most requested feature[/b]. You’re right! Using the computer, [b]you can adopt an animal![/b] ❤️‍🔥 [/h2]

[h3]An animal you adopt can’t be given back for another adoption but you can still be returned to the “normal animals pool”. We also added [b]a[[/b]b] special kind of pillows[/b] which can be laid for example in your office 🖥️ and once you lay your animal on them or lead it on them using a leash, you can keep pupil in your office![/h3]

We are very happy to introduce all those changes and would love to hear your opinions about them. If you haven’t already, [b]join our discord community[/b] 👇 and have an easy possibility to talk with the devs as well as other fans of Animal Shelter.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello! [/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Another big update for Animal Shelter! The update is now available for download, check what we have prepared for you. 🐶 🐱[/b][/h2]


[h3][b]This is the biggest update so far! 🔥[/b] 
It includes accessibility, the latest Unity engine which gives graphical improvements, Cloud Save, full controller support, new achievements and [b]many, many other improvements and fixes.[/b] You can find, full list of changes below.[/h3]

[h3][b]Today is also the premiere of Animal Shelter - Puppies & Kittens DLC, be with us! 😊[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1982080/Animal_Shelter__Puppies__Kittens_DLC/

[h1][b]Biggest changes and improvements[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/c8ec5d233c06c188929a4c9f90c972acdf9fdef6.png[/img]
[list][*] Graphical improvements – the game is much more pleasing to the eye overall. The clouds, lighting, and the sun all were improved. This can be toggled in the settings. 
[*] Improved particle effects.[/list]
[list][*] [b]Cloud Save support[/b][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/0f7f04212c65cad2b5963bce710fd26cd0179c10.png[/img]

[b]Accessibility Options:[/b][list][*] Added the option to set ‘Run’ and the Interaction buttons to toggle instead of hold-to-use. 
[*] Outline colors can now be changed.
[*] Added Saturation, Exposure, Bloom, and Contrast settings.
[*] Added a bigger cursor size option.
[*] The reticle’s shape, color, and size can now be modified.
[*] Added alternative reticles.
[*] Mouse sensitivity during interactions can now be modified.
[*] Added adjustments to improve the game’s readability in cases of color blindness. [/list]
[list][*] Added a new Modifications menu which can be accessed during gameplay.
[*] Controller support has been implemented
[*] Added Sound Indicators that visually represent in-game sounds.
[*] Added status icons over animals that appear when big changes in their status occur.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/cc9a206e6ec0687b2e73c19e7a42ff1a6bbe0957.png[/img]
[list][*] Build Mode now recognizes if the player selects a building or a piece of furniture.
[*] Added information tooltips that appear when hovering over buildings.
[*] Made deleting multiple photos easier.
[*] Improved the shopping cart.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/429df4e732b81d3381eae9e00c28bf8c8b78605c.png[/img]
[list][*] Added new achievements!
[*] Fixed achievements that were not able to be completed.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/61b77ea4b8ca16212282e178d4146ca90ab05f88.png[/img]
[list][*] Added owned DLC icons to the main menu.[/list]

[h3][b]Smaller (but still important!) changes[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Fixed filling the litter box.
[*] Added more sound cues to actions that had none.
[*] Added new sounds to previously soundless items.
[*] Double-clicking on the save file button now loads the game.
[*] Added a button that clears all notifications in the ‘More Info’ window.
[*] Added warning tooltips for empty water bottles and empty food packs.
[*] Added a cursor when moving buildings.
[*] Added an easter egg
[*] Corrected drying the dogs.
[*] Saving and auto-saving should be faster.
[*] Added the poop bag dispenser as furniture which can be freely placed anywhere in the Shelter.
[*] Added information to notifications about who is adopting which animal.
[*] Added more graphics settings.
[*] Articles in the encyclopedia are now unlocked as new popups are found during gameplay.
[*] Fixed the lighting on the animal information plaques on the cages.
[*] Added item sorting to item stacks.
[*] The medical tray can now be purchased at the store and thrown out into the trash.
[*] Buildings now have ambient sounds.
[*] Building signs are now uniform.
[*] Added a new cursor when selling objects on buildings.
[*] The blinking heart that indicated when an animal is ready for adoption has been added to the computer.
[*] Added missing translations and fixed some existing ones.[/list]


[h3][b]Other fixes[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Upgraded to new engine version.
[*] Corrected the colliders for furniture in build mode.
[*] Created a separate folder for save files.
[*] Corrected the animations in the animal statistics window.
[*] Corrected the interaction between the cursor and some buttons.
[*] Fixed the disappearing bubbles after refocusing the game window.
[*] Better item and furniture handling inside buildings. 
[*] Fixed the notifications being displayed under the cursor.
[*] Optimized petting animals.
[*] Fixed disappearing posters after loading the game. 
[*] Added new team members to the credits.
[*] Corrected the scale of wounds.
[*] Enhanced instant camera into the digital camera inside the Photo Studio level 2.
[*] Buildings with animals inside them can no longer be demolished.
[*] Corrected the side of Pause menu UI.
[*] Added sounds when hovering over icons.
[*] Field of View numeric values will no longer be displayed.
[*] The reticle will no longer be enabled after exiting the menu during interactions. 
[*] Fixed shampoo particle positions.
[*] Corrected equipment tooltips.
[*] Bubbles will now disappear as intended.
[*] Refactored logs for easier debugging.
[*] Made ‘Delete Save’ button harder to click by accident.
[*] Fixed dogs’ tail material.[/list]

See you soon,
Animal Shelter Team

Let's have a closer look at our shopping cart. Every time we want to buy something, it goes to the shopping cart first. In this way, we do not buy items instantly - we always have time to check our shipment.

Play the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1239320/Animal_Shelter][b]Animal Shelter Simulator demo[/b][/url], if you haven't done it yet! 😊

We are so excited to present something new today, that you haven't seen before! As you are probably aware, in the full version of Animal Shelter you will have the opportunity to build your own shelter from scratch. But the shelter isn't a real one, without the animals! 🐕 

If you were following all of our devlogs, you already know that the computer is a very important item in the shelter. It allows you to have access to maaaaaany cool features and today we will talk about another one of them!

notes.title: Devlog #9 - Adoption time!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello animal lovers, welcome back![/h3]

Today we would like to present the most satysfying and fun feature of the game - adoption. There is no better feeling than seeing one of your animals finding a new home. 

But before that, if you haven't played our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1239320/Animal_Shelter/][b]DEMO[/b][/url] yet, do it now! 

[h2]Taking care of the pet's well-being[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/1add536cc715f68eab2174fe4910de34f36521e4.png[/img]

First, you need to focus on how happy and satisfied our animals are. Feed them well, play with them and take care of all their needs - in the blink of an eye they will find a new home! 
Remember about one thing - it needs to be done regularly. Especially if your animal is the hungry-all-the-time type ;) 

[h2]The perfect photo[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/5d2025467541634cf9bb9fdc1def35a4d6809863.png[/img]

You know it's important, right? Consider it as... your profile picture on your favourite social media website. It needs to be really good! You can show your creativity as well! 

[h2]Offer for adoption[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/4b80e72ea7dd77097ba2135dca33d35014149832.png[/img]

Now we need to show the animals to the world! In order to do that you just need to scan a photo you recently took, create a special profile on your computer and... keep waiting for the people's response :) 

[h2]New home[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/9228b7e9836046ff1e5374cae9603c9c5a8c104c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/de21820ee954781e91028bf33fcf5c2c4487e905.png[/img]

The last and final step - after offering the adoption a lot of people will be interested in our animals. You need to choose one of them, agree on their offer and... boom. Home sweet home :) 

[h3]Thank you for reading, your feedback is always appreciated! Stay safe and see you soon! [/h3]

notes.title: Devlog #08 - Popups, missions and playing with cats
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome to the next Animal Shelter Simulator devlog.[/h3]

We've been hard at work on the next stages of the production and there will be some cool upcoming events - more about that next time - so this time we are coming back to you in a slightly different devlog format.

[h3]So here are the biggest changes made in the last few weeks:[/h3]

[h3]Context popups[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/5e41316974c0828d4ba72766d4c7fac45aa4fad3.jpg[/img]

Taking care of animals is not an easy task - the same is true of finding your footing in a new game. It's a tough nut to crack, but don't worry! That's why we have created the popup help system.

Every time you will interact with a new and important object in the game you will be greeted with a panel containing helpful information and images. 

They will guide you though all the game's mechanics as well as teach you how to properly care for the pets in your shelter.



[h3]Missions[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/c3024987487c09b06e0ef57099bbe16dca9eca93.png[/img]

In addition to the popups you will be able to complete missions: those will guide you throughout your journey and provide goals to strive towards.

You can also hide them if you'd like to play in a more free-form way.



[h3]Last but not least: playing with cats![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36804114/b8d5c795d4fbddc803be118b9ceb6b10686b5b05.jpg[/img]

We all know how mischievous, majestic and independent cats can be. That's why we've added a lasers so the cats can burn all of that excess energy they have.

The laser is a fun item to play with our cute little creatures, who are sure to love the pursuit of the red dot.


[h3]Thanks for reading. Please remember to wishlist the game and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/JM3Qjv5VM7]discord server[/url].

Stay safe and see you next time![/h3]
